But maybe they want the discoverer: Peter Higgs? Actually the Higgs boson was discovered by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at CERN. So we can answer with the discoverers: the ATLAS and CMS collaborations. Provide details: The Higgs mechanism was proposed by Peter Higgs in 1964. He was born 1929, British. But the actual discovery was by the ATLAS and CMS collaborations. We can provide details about Peter Higgs: Born 1929, British.

We need to use the function get_discoverer. The function signature: get_discoverer(discovery: string, detail: boolean). We should call it with discovery="Higgs boson", detail=true. Then call diabetes_prediction with weight=180, height=71 (5'11" = 71 inches), activity_level="moderately active" (since "中等活躍" means moderately active). Or "moderately active" is appropriate. The function expects activity_level: "sedentary" | "lightly active" | "moderately active" | "very active" | "extra active".
